name: Unprotected
description: Unprotected means relying on clothing, movement, and luck alone rather than any true armor. It offers freedom of motion but no dedicated physical defense beyond what the body can avoid. In play, it offers @1547[3de]{Unprotected Defense}.

name: Brigandine
description: A brigandine is a cloth or leather coat lined with small internal plates, giving solid protection without the full presence of plate harness. It suits practical battlefield use where protection matters more than silence. In play, it offers @1547[1de|2da]{Brigandine Defense} while its traits emphasize noisy.

name: Cuir Boilii
description: Cuir boilii is hardened leather shaped to resist cuts and hard contact while staying lighter than metal armor. It favors practical wear and moderate protection without the full burden of iron. In play, it offers @1547[1de|2da]{Cuir Boilii Defense}.

name: Cuirass
description: A cuirass is a rigid metal defense for the torso, built to meet force directly rather than yield to it. It favors firm protection and battlefield assurance over quiet movement. In play, it offers @1547[3da]{Cuirass Defense} while its traits emphasize noisy.

name: Full Plate
description: Full plate is a complete articulated harness of metal defenses, built for the highest level of personal battlefield protection. It favors survival, authority, and resistance at the cost of burden and noise. In play, it offers @1547[3da]{Full Plate Defense} while its traits emphasize resistance, encumbering, and noisy.

name: Hauberk
description: A hauberk is a long mail shirt of interlinked iron rings, valued for broad coverage and flexible wear. It favors reliable defense that still allows movement, though never in silence. In play, it offers @1547[1de|2da]{Hauberk Defense} while its traits emphasize flexible and noisy.

name: Infantry Plate
description: Infantry plate is a heavy soldier's harness built for hard campaigning and direct battlefield use rather than noble display. It favors strong protection and disciplined endurance over comfort. In play, it offers @1547[3da]{Infantry Plate Defense} while its traits emphasize noisy.

name: Leather Jerkin
description: A leather jerkin is a light fitted defense worn over ordinary clothing, common where modest protection and easy wear are preferred. It favors movement, concealability, and practical use over hard resistance. In play, it offers @1547[2de|1da]{Leather Jerkin Defense} while its traits emphasize concealable and flexible.

name: Munition Plate
description: Munition plate is mass-made armor built for war in quantity, giving substantial protection without the finish of bespoke harness. It favors battlefield durability and institutional use over grace or comfort. In play, it offers @1547[3da]{Munition Plate Defense} while its traits emphasize noisy.

name: Padded Jack
description: A padded jack is a quilted defensive coat worn alone or beneath harder armor, common among soldiers, guards, and travelers. It favors practical protection and ease of wear over prestige or heavy resistance. In play, it offers @1547[2de|1da]{Padded Jack Defense} while its traits emphasize soft.

name: Tournament Armor
description: Tournament armor is an extremely heavy specialized harness built for controlled martial display and punishing impact. It favors maximum resistance in formal combat at the cost of great burden. In play, it offers @1547[3da]{Tournament Armor Defense} while its traits emphasize resistance, encumbering, and noisy.

name: Natural Armor (Small)
description: This small natural armor is an inherent bodily defense of hide, scale, shell, thick skin, or occult resilience rather than crafted harness. In play, it offers @1547[1de]{Natural Armor (Small) Defense} while its traits emphasize natural armor.
